name: HugeProfit CRM
author: hugeprofit

sections.description:
HugeProfit is a CRM system for inventory management, sales, and customer communication, integrated with WooCommerce.

With this plugin, you can:

  • Automatically sync orders from WooCommerce to HugeProfit
  • Manage stock and warehouse inventory
  • Track profits by product or customer
  • Monitor detailed sales analytics
  • Communicate with customers directly through the system

Perfect for:
– Online stores
– Businesses operating on marketplaces
– Small and medium-sized enterprises

🎯 Why HugeProfit?
– Set up in minutes
– Accessible from web, mobile app
– Free plan available (up to 50 sales/month)

Official Website | Try it Free

External services

This plugin connects to external services to provide CRM functionality and ensure reliable access to the HugeProfit API:

1. HugeProfit CRM Service (crm.h-profit.com)
– Purpose: Main CRM service integration for order synchronization, inventory management, and analytics
– Data sent: WooCommerce orders, product information, customer data, API authentication tokens
– When: During order sync, inventory updates, and API authentication
– Terms of Service: https://h-profit.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://h-profit.com/privacy

2. Mirror URL Service (ingwest.net)
– Purpose: Service discovery to obtain the current working mirror URL for HugeProfit API access
– Data sent: Application identifier (“wordpress”) only
– When: When the plugin needs to discover the current working API endpoint
– Terms of Service: https://ingwest.net/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://ingwest.net/privacy

The plugin requires these external services to function properly. Data transmission occurs only when necessary for CRM operations and service discovery.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the ZIP archive.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > HugeProfit CRM and enter your API key or Follow the Setup Wizard to connect your WordPress plugin to your CRM system.
  4. You can find the key in your HugeProfit account settings.
sections.faq:
Is the integration free?

Yes, it’s available on all plans, including the free one.

Does the plugin sync stock quantities?

Yes, product stock is automatically synced from HugeProfit to WooCommerce.

How do I get the API key?

The API key can be generated in your HugeProfit dashboard and entered in the plugin settings.

Can I set the product cost directly in the WooCommerce product page?

Yes, you can enter the cost price directly in the product settings.

Can I log expenses like rent, purchasing, or salaries to calculate profit?

Yes, you can record any type of business expenses from all accounts inside HugeProfit.

Can I see profit per product, per order, and by month?

Yes, you’ll be able to view profitability per product, per order, or for any selected period — including detailed business-wide reports.
